title: Map: Plan of the Battle of Uhud
headingPashto: نقشه: د احد د جګړې نقشه

paras.en: Plan of the Battle of Uhud — in the valley between Mount Aynayn and Mount Uhud the Messenger of Allah arranged his army and posted archers on the pass of Uhud. Later Khalid bin Walid came from behind and attacked the Muslims.
paras.ur: جنگِ احد کا نقشہ — جبلِ عینین اور جبلِ احد کے درمیان وادی میں رسول اللہ نے اپنے لشکر کو ترتیب دیا اور درۂ احد پر تیر انداز مقرر فرمائے۔ بعد میں خالد بن ولید نے پیچھے سے آ کر مسلمانوں پر حملہ کیا۔
paras.ps: د احد د جګړې نقشه — د عینین او احد د غرونو ترمنځ په دره کې رسول الله خپل لښکر تنظیم کړ او د احد پر درې یې غشي ویشتونکي وټاکل. وروسته خالد بن ولید له شا راغی او پر مسلمانانو یې برید وکړ.

sourceNote: Printed page 60: a full-page plan map titled “جنگِ احد کا نقشہ”, redrawn schematically (mountains, the positions, Mount Aynayn, the Quraysh army, arrows). The explanatory box at the bottom of the plan is in tiny handwriting and cannot be read reliably; the caption sentence given here is a summary of its sense (the Muslim positions between the two mountains, the archers on the pass and the attack from behind) and needs checking against a better scan. A thumb at the lower edge is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
